body:
Chrome does NOT fail when its --remote-debugging-port is already taken: it silently picks another port. A CDP driver that then fetches 127.0.0.1:<port>/json/version attaches to whatever was ALREADY there — a leftover browser from a previous run, with a stale extension build and stale storage.

Symptom: a baffling error from code you just fixed (seen for real: 'e.find is not a function' thrown by a v1 build still running on the port). Nothing in the output hints that the wrong browser is being driven.

Three fixes, all needed: refuse to launch when the port already answers; register cleanup handlers (uncaughtException / unhandledRejection / SIGINT / SIGTERM) so a failing driver still kills its browser; and pkill leftovers before every e2e run.
